svg.title: Nafas documentation-based ERD — SSMS review reported
svg.desc: Eighteen tables and twenty-four documented relationships. Project owner reports SSMS review of 18 tables, 110 columns, keys, foreign keys, indexes, and CHECK constraints; all inspected foreign keys are enabled and trusted. Exact catalog export was not supplied for object-by-object reconciliation.
svg.text: SSMS review reported by project owner · 18 tables / 110 columns · Object details reflect database-data.js
Cardinality: M = many · 1 = exactly one · 0..1 = optional one. Lines connect documented FK columns to referenced columns.
Exact catalog export not supplied for object-by-object reconciliation; application authorization rules are not represented here.
